recent_en: EI Power recently secured a RM14.79 million subcontract for a diesel fuel system and announced the acquisition of a factory property in Shah Alam for RM17.2 million. The company released its quarterly results in August 2026, and there have also been changes in substantial shareholder interests.
notable_en: Secured a RM14.79 million subcontract for a diesel fuel system.
Proposed acquisition of a freehold land with a two-and-a-half storey semi-detached factory in Shah Alam for RM17.2 million.
Change in substantial shareholder interest by Mr Siew Wei Foo.
